messages:
Maria (Marketing): Quick sync — finalizing the release announce. Need a few things from eng/docs before we go live: changelog blurb, canonical docs links, final benchmark stats for the blog/webinar, and a confirmed canary window. Also need inbound lead routing tag for the webinar signups and a 1-line social copy for the tweet/post. Deck is here: https://redwood.app/s/launch-deck (draft).
Henry (Eng): Working on changelog now. Will push a short bullet here in a min.
Oliver (Docs): I can publish docs links. Which model/version should examples reference? Also confirm if we want code samples with the new param names.
Maria (Marketing): Use redwood-m3.1 for examples and call out "dedicated" vs "hosted" snippets. Keep samples tiny.
Henry (Eng): Changelog draft pasted below:
```
- Added model routing rules and canary flag for redwood-m3.1; improved prefix caching semantics; corrected token accounting for streaming responses.
```
Henry (Eng): Canary plan proposal: roll to 5% for first 30m, 20% next 90m, then full at end of day if no regressions. Target window Wed Mar 27 14:00-17:00 UTC.
Sasha (Product): +1 on canary. Suggest we gate the first hour to 2% not 5% and enable automatic rollback on error-rate > 2.5%. Also can we pick the benchmark number we want to headline? Latency p50 and cost-per-1k tokens ideally.
Maria (Marketing): For the blog headline use p50 latency on 2k context and token cost delta vs baseline. Can you send the final numbers?
Henry (Eng): Quick numbers from perf lab (pre-quant): p50=38ms @2k ctx, cost delta -18% vs baseline. I'll attach the perf run id afterwards.
Leo (release-bot): changelog-draft uploaded to /releases/1795556666/changelog.md — https://ci.redwood/release/1795556666 (status: staging).
Oliver (Docs): I pushed the docs draft under staging: https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/release-1795556666 — examples reference redwood-m3.1 and show hosted/dedicated snippets. Will publish final at 11:45 UTC.
Jin (Growth): For inbound routing: tag = launch-webinar-2026, route to SF-SDR queue and create a filter in HubSpot for "webinar:launch". I'll wire that up once we have the final form link.
Maria (Marketing): Social one-liner from eng would help — short, punchy. Can we get a 100-char max line?
Henry (Eng): One-liner: "Redwood lowers gen latency by 18% and ships smarter model routing with redwood-m3.1."
Maria (Marketing): Nice — we'll iterate but that works. Oliver, confirm docs URL published?
Oliver (Docs): Published: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/1795556666 — includes changelog, quickstart, and sample requests.
Maria (Marketing): Great. Final checklist: (1) changelog ✔️, (2) docs link ✔️, (3) canary window Wed Mar 27 14:00-17:00 UTC with 2%→20% ramp and rollback threshold 2.5% ✔️, (4) perf numbers p50=38ms, -18% cost ✔️, (5) inbound tag launch-webinar-2026 -> SF-SDR (Jin will setup) ✔️, (6) social one-liner ready ✔️.
Sasha (Product): I'll monitor metrics during canary and stand by for rollback.
Maria (Marketing): Going to lock the announcement in the scheduler once Jin confirms HubSpot filter and Oliver confirms final doc anchor. Thanks y'all :tada:
Henry (Eng): Backing out to on-call but ping me if we see >1.5x error jump.
Leo (release-bot): Canary rollout scheduled: 2026-03-27T14:00:00Z -> 2026-03-27T17:00:00Z, initial weight 2% (auto-rollout rules applied).
Maria (Marketing): Perfect — closing thread, will post a brief prep note to #all-hands an hour before.
